description: Fixed, named operations on Thunderbird's own windows. There is deliberately no way to run arbitrary code.

functions.name: captureWindow
functions.description: PNG of the main window as a data URL, with its size

functions.name: snapshot
functions.description: The shown, labelled interactive elements of the main window and the mail view, with refs

functions.name: click
functions.description: Move the agent cursor to an element and click it with real mouse events

functions.name: type
functions.description: Type into a field, optionally clearing it first and pressing Enter after

functions.name: pressKey
functions.description: Press an allowed key on whatever has focus

functions.name: updateAddon
functions.description: Update an installed, unsigned add-on from a local .xpi file

functions.name: hideAgent
functions.description: Take the agent cursor off the window

functions.name: readPairingToken
functions.description: The token the MCP Bridge server keeps in ~/.foxmcp/pairing-token, or null when the file does not exist
